_comment: C0-2 正文英译 · codebuddy（2026-10-24）。axes=八维单元格；runs/unknowns=实测记录与未知项；related/sources=按索引对齐的理由与出处标签。
_rules: 0) 保留 ** 强调、`code`、链接与表格结构，与中文侧逐块对应。
1) 官方英文引文原样保留；档案里的中文转述引文在英文侧标注 (translated)，不伪造英文原文。
2) 「未核验/官方未给」等未知语义不升级；不借翻译改事实。

axes.model_access: **The official docs state explicitly**: besides Tencent's self-developed Hunyuan LLM, other LLMs can be connected and switched (the official product-overview page names DeepSeek as an example). The concrete selectable list follows versions; not enumerated one by one. The international edition (codebuddy.ai) and domestic edition (codebuddy.cn) are two lines whose model surfaces may differ — each official page is authoritative.
axes.runtime: **Official framing: "plugin, IDE and CLI cover all development scenarios"** — the IDE plugin (VS Code / JetBrains family), the standalone AI IDE (codebuddy.cn/ide), and the command-line form each have official docs pages. Execution happens on your machine (common to the plugin/IDE/CLI forms; this site's judgement — the official does not state execution location page by page).
axes.local_files: Code lives in your local editor/project. The IDE form's deployment line (CloudStudio one-click deploy: a sandbox environment generates a share link) **uploads artifacts to the Tencent Cloud side** — upload scope and retention policy not verified one by one.
axes.background: **No official statement of a background-resident/async task surface was found.** All three forms lead with interactive sessions (checked the official docs navigation; no background-agent page — "not verified" does not mean "does not exist").
axes.tools: The official docs include an MCP configuration surface (within the IDE docs navigation); an enterprise-side article mentions MCP-server allowlist configuration (paraphrasing the official; capability details not verified one by one). Design-to-code (Figma import generating pages) is one of the official flagship scenarios.
axes.context: The enterprise edition has a RAG knowledge base (stated explicitly on the official product-overview page: a team-specific knowledge base that enhances Q&A and coding). The personal edition's memory surface is not verified one by one.
axes.permissions: Account system (Tencent Cloud accounts). The enterprise edition has an admin console (audit logs, custom secure-coding instructions, etc. — paraphrased from official Tencent Cloud developer articles). Data surface: the official leads with a "meets domestic security requirements" compliance narrative (Tencent Cloud official PDF wording, contrasted with ChatGPT).
axes.fit:
Good fit: domestic teams wanting a compliance narrative (Hunyuan is filed), one-stop build-to-deploy inside the Tencent Cloud ecosystem (CloudBase/CloudStudio), plugin + IDE + CLI switching under one account.

Not a fit: wanting to self-select from a global model list (the model surface follows what the official lists), deep dependence on overseas SaaS integration chains.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md).

**Suggested measurement** (three, each pointing at something the official readable pages do not give):

- **A feature-difference list between the domestic and international editions** (each has its own official pages; no comparison table)
- **The actual capability boundary of the CLI form** (the CLI page is the thinnest in the official three-client narrative)
- **Retention and access control of CloudStudio deployment artifacts**
unknowns:
- The complete current model list (changes with versions; not enumerated one by one)
- Detailed capability surface of the CLI form (official docs are thin; not verified one by one)
- Personal-edition memory/context mechanism details (not verified one by one)
- Background/async task surface (not verified to an official statement)
related: Both are China-origin big-vendor coding assistants: Alibaba Cloud's line runs the "first-party product + whole-suite Credits" narrative; this site has not verified a filing number for it. CodeBuddy's Hunyuan filing number is checkable in the official docs.
Both are China-origin coding tools going overseas: ByteDance's IDE line, with the SOLO-mode narrative.
